semantics: Residual means no DIRECT named P0-case attachment. It does not mean untested effect or automatically demand 70 individual simulations. Classification is decision-relevance triage, not Oracle or M6 certification.
explicit_still_open: No new material named Abaddon P0/P1 mechanical case is currently identified from this reconciled 70-source-name set. New discovered exact Oracle contradiction reopens gate.

Relevant P1 non-execution dispositions include unobservable opponent-library/creature metagame distributions, generic stack/card-access variations and complete multiplayer victory rates. None is represented as a passed test or a statistically proved optimum.
M6 I tested-pool local-optimum certificate and final J reproducibility bundle are separate uncompleted artifacts; M6.10 owner acceptance and all M7 exact approvals remain blocked.
